description: Fifty hand-authored synthetic evidence tasks. Ranking labels are source-level graded relevance, not model truth judgments. Not a real-user or semantic-model benchmark.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures measure regression behavior on known evidence, not real-user retrieval quality.
No semantic model or answer generation is evaluated; answer faithfulness and belief correctness remain unassessed.
Source-level rankings deduplicate passages by full source identity. MRR and graded nDCG use cutoff 5. Empty relevance cases are scored as abstention, outside ranking averages.
Context delivery means the exact approved text is present in the rendered provider packet; it does not claim that a model attended to or followed it.
